# Segmetrics

SegMetrics is a marketing analytics platform that provides detailed insights into customer journeys, helping businesses optimize their marketing strategies.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/segmetrics/.

## Actions

- **Add or Update Contact**: Add or update a contact in segmetrics.
- **Create Product**: Create a new product in segmetrics.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete a specific contact by id.
